dash.liveUpdatesPaused: Live updates paused — reconnecting. Data refreshes about once a minute in the meantime.
dash.apiUnreachable: Can't reach RealmSwap right now — showing the last known state. It reconnects automatically once the app is back.
dash.friendJoinedToast: Your first friend is online — game night is officially real. 🎉
wizard.title: Deploy your first server
wizard.subtitle: Three quick steps. RealmSwap downloads and configures everything — you just pick a game.
wizard.step.name: Name It
wizard.error.definitions: Couldn't load the game list — the app may still be starting. Reopen this page in a moment.
wizard.error.emptyCatalog: No games are available yet — import a game definition or ask the server owner to.
wizard.error.snapshots: Could not enable snapshots — set them on the Backups page.
wizard.catalogEmpty.title: No games in the catalog
wizard.catalogEmpty.admin: The built-in catalog loads when the app starts — restarting usually restores it. You can also import a Pterodactyl egg from Settings → Administration.
wizard.catalogEmpty.member: The built-in catalog loads when the app starts — restarting usually restores it. Otherwise, ask the server owner to import a game definition.
wizard.passwordPlaceholder: Leave empty for an open server
wizard.downloadNote: ℹ️ Heads up: the first start downloads the game server files automatically — that's a one-time multi-minute download, and progress shows right on the server card.
wizard.downloadNoteJava: ℹ️ Heads up: the first start downloads the game server files and the right Java runtime automatically — that's a one-time multi-minute download, and progress shows right on the server card.
wizard.readyBody: Press Start on its card to boot it the first time — the game files download automatically. Three optional setup steps while you're here:
wizard.tunnel.title: Friends outside your LAN?
wizard.tunnel.body: RealmSwap can tunnel the server through playit.gg and claim it for you automatically.
wizard.s3.title: Offsite backups
wizard.s3.bodyOn: Snapshots also copy to your own S3 bucket.
wizard.s3.bodyOff: Copy snapshots to your own S3 bucket so a dead disk can't take the worlds with it.
wizard.snapshots.title: Nightly snapshots
wizard.snapshots.bodyOn: A snapshot every 24 hours — change it anytime on the Backups page.
wizard.skipNote: Everything above is optional — skip any of it.
checklist.title: Get your first friend online
checklist.subtitle: Four steps between you and game night — RealmSwap handles the rest.
checklist.boot.title: Boot the server once
checklist.boot.done: It's been online — the world is waiting.
checklist.boot.todo: Press Start on the card above — the first boot downloads the game files for you.
checklist.mods.title: Add your first mods
checklist.mods.todo: Optional — search Modrinth, CurseForge, Thunderstore or Steam Workshop and install in one click.
checklist.invite.title: Share Join Info
checklist.invite.done: Invite minted — friends scan or click to auto-install every mod and join.
checklist.invite.todo: One link or QR: your friend's client gets every mod and config it needs.
checklist.friend.title: First friend joins
checklist.friend.done: Someone's in — game night is real.
checklist.friend.todo: We watch the player count for you and check this off automatically.
celebrate.title: Your server is live!
celebrate.body: '{name}' just came online for the first time. Time to invite some friends.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.body: Choose the language for the RealmSwap interface. More languages arrive with each release.
